phase: Software acceptance and bounded reliability verified; shop device and operational gates pending
assessmentNote: A reviewed roadmap score, not a probability of safety or an estimate of remaining engineering hours. Completion earns credit only for the stated acceptance scope and evidence. Production rollout remains blocked until every release gate is verified. Future optional features are excluded from the initial-release score.

evidence.title: Architecture and source audit
evidence.result: Reviewed controller/service/DTO boundaries, decimal mappings, constraints, same-origin hosting, and the existing operating guides against source at baseline afe3b92.

evidence.title: PostgreSQL and authenticated API tests
evidence.result: 96 backend cases passed, including three discounted/free product allocation and refund regressions, 11 acceptance isolation guards and the existing commerce/authentication/restricted-database/LAN checks.

evidence.title: Frontend totals and accessible forms
evidence.result: 32 frontend cases pass: previous 24 plus five scanner queue/unknown/stock/focus/race cases and three same-origin/unreachable-server feedback cases.

evidence.title: Built application browser acceptance
evidence.result: 14 Chromium workflows passed on isolated loopback HTTPS with strict Node CA validation, including full-catalog weighted checkout, complete cashier browser navigation and employee creation/password reset/deactivation/reactivation. Native PC/phone trust and physical device acceptance remain pending.

evidence.title: Sales slip generation and rendering
evidence.result: Baseline PDF parsed and rendered to PNG, long receipt xref/escaping checked, and 80 mm browser print inspected. Scope is the supported ASCII PDF and browser layout; no physical printer or 58 mm acceptance was recorded.

evidence.title: Local build, publish and recovery drill
evidence.result: Recorded baseline Release publish and healthy local app; custom backup/checksum restored into a separate database with expected table counts. Does not prove managed startup, an operational least-privilege role or off-site failover.

evidence.title: Application safeguards and dependency audit
evidence.result: Identity, cookie settings, CSRF, role attributes, immutable ledgers and safe SQL were reviewed. Baseline npm/NuGet audits reported no advisories; no independent penetration or compliance review is claimed.

evidence.title: Cloud preparation design review
evidence.result: Reviewed the local authority, no-bidirectional-sync initial scope, outbox/inbox deduplication proposal and conflict risks. This verifies the documented design only, not a running cloud or synchronization implementation.

evidence.title: Restricted-role HTTPS staging and exact recovery drill
evidence.result: Separate fictional cluster/database, restricted runtime and separate migration identities, localhost TLS validated with explicit test trust, private configuration and DPAPI keys. All API/commerce tests use restricted grants; HTTPS browser refund/utang/stock regression passes. Runtime backup restored as migration owner into a disposable database: all 36 table/sequence states and stock/cash/credit/refund/last receipt reconciliation match. No OS certificate trust, firewall/service changes or production acceptance is claimed.

evidence.title: LAN configuration, keyboard scanning, thermal layouts and interruption simulation
evidence.result: Separate fictional LAN profile defaults to loopback only; proposed minishop.local is configurable. Restricted roles, explicit private IPv4/host/DB guards, private CA/SAN/time and wrong-host rejection checks are exercised. Keyboard scans use fresh exact lookups with queue/unknown/duplicate/stock/focus tests. Browser/PDF 58/80 mm previews and simulated WAN/local interruption workflows have dedicated checks. TLS-verifying Node transport replaces the earlier browser certificate-exception flag. No physical scanner/printer, native phone/PC trust, actual LAN binding or WAN hardware acceptance is claimed. The separate fictional LAN backup/restore drill matches all 36 public table/sequence states and stock/cash/credit/refund/last-receipt totals through the restricted role; original data is unchanged. No operator/off-site recovery acceptance is claimed.

evidence.title: Fictional full software acceptance and reconciliation
evidence.result: 300 fictional products, 24 baseline households, two cashiers; 17 acceptance scenarios, 96 backend, 32 frontend and 14 browser workflows passed. 120 bounded concurrent baskets, scarce-stock/credit-limit races, retry safety, complete cashier role denials, cent-exact reports, CSV/PDF layouts, restricted-role backup/restore and exact controlled-restart/session reconciliation verified. Long-duration soak, abrupt power failure, browser matrix and physical devices remain unverified.

milestones.title: Foundation and architecture
milestones.summary: The local application, PostgreSQL schema, service boundaries and setup workflow are established.

tasks.title: Application foundation and build
tasks.detail: React/TypeScript and ASP.NET Core 10 projects build with pinned dependencies and an explicit health endpoint.

tasks.title: Database schema and migrations
tasks.detail: Two EF migrations establish Identity, shop relations, precision, indexes, stock constraints and ledger triggers; real integration fixtures apply them.

tasks.title: Modular monolith boundaries
tasks.detail: Controllers, DTOs, services, entities and persistence have distinct roles; checkout rules use one transactional writer.

tasks.title: Frontend/backend communication
tasks.detail: Same-origin cookie requests and Vite proxy connect actual API data; no shop totals are static mock data.

tasks.title: Setup and architecture guides
tasks.detail: The requested beginner, C#, database, API, user and deployment guides and Windows helpers have been reviewed against implemented paths.

milestones.title: Frontend and user experience
milestones.summary: Operational pages work; comprehensive accessibility and large-catalog acceptance remain.

tasks.title: Routing and responsive shell
tasks.detail: Login, owner routing, sidebar/mobile navigation and the existing light-theme shell support the tested desktop/mobile flow.

tasks.title: Connected operational pages
tasks.detail: Dashboard, cashier, catalog, delivery, customers, credit, sales, reports, employees and settings call live APIs.

tasks.title: Validation, empty and error states
tasks.detail: Shared RHF/Zod forms and API error handling exist; basic forms are tested, but rejection/timeout cases are not comprehensively exercised on every page.
tasks.next: Exercise server validation, timeout, loading and empty states on every operational page.

tasks.title: Keyboard and mobile accessibility
tasks.detail: Labeled controls, focus styles, modal dialogs and reduced motion exist. One 390 px overflow check is not full keyboard, screen-reader or multi-browser acceptance.
tasks.next: Run keyboard-only, screen-reader, contrast and representative phone/browser acceptance.

tasks.title: Large-catalog and ledger navigation
tasks.detail: Product/sales/movement/audit pagination exists, but customer, batch and ledger views cap results and selectors are limited.
tasks.next: Add server-paged customer/batch/ledger navigation and test representative data volumes.

milestones.title: Inventory and POS
milestones.summary: Core stock, checkout and controlled full-refund invariants have real database coverage.

tasks.title: Product and category management
tasks.detail: Owner create/edit/deactivate, unique SKU/barcode, units, prices, search and validation are checked through the API and browser.

tasks.title: Receiving, adjustments and expiry allocation
tasks.detail: Batches retain actual cost and expiry; FEFO excludes expired stock; negative final stock and ledger rewriting are rejected.

tasks.title: Atomic and idempotent checkout
tasks.detail: Sale, payment, stock and credit writes share a transaction; concurrent requests cannot oversell and retries cannot duplicate a sale.

tasks.title: Weighted quantities, cash and discounts
tasks.detail: Whole-piece/decimal weight rules, server price snapshots, cent rounding, discount totals and change are tested.

tasks.title: Controlled full-sale reversal
tasks.detail: Owner refund appends compensating records, restores original allocations and separates cash returned from remaining debt. Partial refunds are outside this acceptance scope.

milestones.title: Utang and employee management
milestones.summary: Accounting and basic authentication are verified; broader employee lifecycle acceptance remains.

tasks.title: Named customers and immutable credit
tasks.detail: Customer charges, optional limits and computed balances preserve append-only history rather than overwriting a balance.

tasks.title: Partial/full repayments and credit refunds
tasks.detail: Oldest-debt allocation, limits, overpayment rejection, concurrent/duplicate repayments and refund credit allocation are tested.

tasks.title: Employee authentication and roles
tasks.detail: Identity hashing, owner/cashier authorization, CSRF and login/logout work within the tested local API/browser scope.

tasks.title: Employee lifecycle and revoked sessions
tasks.detail: Restricted-role API tests cover two-session revocation, lockout/expiry and logout. Chromium now verifies employee creation, password-reset revocation, deactivation and reactivation. Actual shop-client and operator account-recovery acceptance remains pending.
tasks.next: Exercise the complete employee lifecycle and multi-session revocation through the browser on actual shop clients.

tasks.title: Full cashier permission acceptance
tasks.detail: Both cashiers denied all 22 tested owner-only operations plus private progress API; discount/credit-limit attempts and cross-cashier sale/PDF access denied. Real cashier browser sale, hidden owner navigation and all direct owner routes pass automated acceptance.

milestones.title: Receipts and reports
milestones.summary: Text PDFs, browser receipts and core financial aggregates work; full formatting/export acceptance remains.

tasks.title: Downloadable supported-text PDF slips
tasks.detail: PDF generation, escaping, long receipts, xref offsets and supported-text rendering are verified; unsupported Unicode remains a documented limitation.

tasks.title: 80 mm browser thermal layout
tasks.detail: The browser print layout hides application chrome, displays item/payment details and renders an 80 mm slip; physical output is tracked separately.

tasks.title: 58 mm, settings and archival identity
tasks.detail: Both 58/80 mm preview/PDF widths, long names, aligned amounts and print-media offsets are exercised. Store/default width remains configurable. Historical store/customer identity is still mutable and requires a policy/implementation decision.
tasks.next: Complete actual printer/configuration acceptance and decide/implement immutable historical receipt identity where required.

tasks.title: Sales and gross profit analytics
tasks.detail: Date ranges, discounted item revenue, cost snapshots and compensating refunds are checked against real PostgreSQL data.

tasks.title: Inventory, credit and CSV reports
tasks.detail: Inventory/credit exports and formula-safe CSV are implemented. Broader reconciliation, dataset volume and spreadsheet-application acceptance are incomplete.
tasks.next: Reconcile inventory/credit/date-range exports to fixture totals and inspect them in target spreadsheet tools.

milestones.title: Automated testing
milestones.summary: Existing automated workflows pass; long-running and platform-wide coverage is not complete.

tasks.title: Backend regression suite
tasks.detail: Real PostgreSQL, HTTP and business-rule tests pass; actual run totals are recorded separately.

tasks.title: Frontend regression suite
tasks.detail: Vitest/RTL decimal, form and progress tests are repeatable; this is a completed suite, not a claim of complete UI coverage.

tasks.title: Built-app browser workflows
tasks.detail: Real-API Playwright checkout/credit/recovery/logout workflows are executable against the built app.

tasks.title: Concurrency and uncertain response testing
tasks.detail: Overselling, duplicate requests, rollback, over-collection and a committed response lost before reload/retry have explicit coverage.

tasks.title: Soak, power failure and browser matrix
tasks.detail: A repeatable isolated fictional workload verifies 120 baskets at concurrency eight plus stock/credit races, exact ledgers, controlled process restart, preserved secure session and separate-database restore. Long-duration soak, abrupt power/process interruption and a supported-browser matrix remain unverified.
tasks.next: Extend bounded tests to long-duration load, crash/power interruption and actual supported browsers, with operator-reviewed reconciliation.

milestones.title: Hardware and local network deployment
milestones.summary: Local operation is proven; the shop's physical devices and trusted LAN are not accepted.

tasks.title: Local Windows build and recovery tools
tasks.detail: Build/start, Release hosting, health and the separate-database backup restore drill have recorded successful results.

tasks.title: Physical thermal printer acceptance
tasks.detail: 58/80 mm browser previews, print media and width-matched fixed-glyph PDFs have automated layout/content tests. No physical printer, driver, paper or cutter is selected/accepted.
tasks.next: Owner supplies the intended printer and paper; record accepted 58/80 mm output and repeated-print results.

tasks.title: Physical barcode scanner acceptance
tasks.detail: USB HID/typed Enter input now has exact API lookups, queued duplicate/unknown/stock/focus/slow-response tests. No physical scanner model has been selected or tested.
tasks.next: Select/acquire a USB HID scanner, configure its layout/Enter suffix and record actual rapid/duplicate/unknown/weighted/focus acceptance.

tasks.title: Trusted HTTPS LAN and WAN-loss drill
tasks.detail: Separate private-CA/SAN/role profile, proposed minishop.local and default loopback rehearsal are verified; external-origin loss and local-request interruption are simulated. Approved device trust, actual LAN/DNS/router access and real WAN-loss acceptance remain pending.
tasks.next: Provision trusted HTTPS on the shop LAN and verify phone/PC sales through WAN loss and recovery.

tasks.title: Managed startup and operational recovery
tasks.detail: Technical staging restore now reconciles every public table/sequence and stock/cash/credit/refund/receipt totals through the restricted role. Managed service restart, scheduled/off-site recovery and operator-led restored-app acceptance remain outstanding.
tasks.next: Configure least-privilege managed startup, scheduled protected backups and an operator-led restored-app recovery drill.

milestones.title: Security and production readiness
milestones.summary: Application safeguards exist; deployed security and commercial acceptance remain release gates.

tasks.title: Identity, CSRF and role safeguards
tasks.detail: Supported session/permission safeguards are source-reviewed and exercised by authenticated API tests. This is not an independent security certification.

tasks.title: Financial constraints and audit history
tasks.detail: Sensitive operations append audit records and protected financial/stock ledgers reject SQL history changes.

tasks.title: Dependency advisory review
tasks.detail: The recorded npm and transitive NuGet review found no reported advisories in its queried graph on the stated date. Future advisories require another review.

tasks.title: Production TLS, roles and secret handling
tasks.detail: Isolated localhost HTTPS, separate restricted runtime/migration roles, private staging configuration, DPAPI keys and a reconciled backup restore are exercised with fictional data. OS/mobile certificate trust, separate service identity and real operational credentials remain unverified.
tasks.next: Obtain approval for certificate trust and a reviewed LAN profile; separate service/provisioner OS access, verify renewal and initialize a fresh non-demo operational database with owner acceptance.

tasks.title: Independent security and invoicing acceptance
tasks.detail: Independent security review and the shop's invoicing/BIR and retention acceptance require qualified external reviewers and owner decisions.
tasks.next: Record qualified security and invoicing/privacy/retention review results and resolve findings before commercial rollout.

milestones.title: Cloud preparation
milestones.summary: This score covers architecture preparation, not implemented cloud synchronization.

tasks.title: Local authority and service boundary design
tasks.detail: The architecture explicitly keeps checkout authoritative in one transactional store and avoids an unsafe bidirectional first release.

tasks.title: Synchronization risks and conflict outline
tasks.detail: Documented outbox/inbox deduplication, global identities, ordering, conflict and privacy risks were reviewed as a design artifact only.

tasks.title: Cloud deployment packaging preparation
tasks.detail: A framework-dependent local Release publish works. Cloud manifests, managed secrets and hosting validation are not implemented.
tasks.next: Choose a hosting target and prepare staging manifests, managed PostgreSQL, secrets and health probes.

tasks.title: Versioned outbox event contract
tasks.detail: No versioned event schema, ownership policy or replay contract has been drafted in source.
tasks.next: Design and review the event contract and reconciliation invariants before implementing synchronization.

tasks.title: Cloud monitoring and recovery runbook
tasks.detail: Cloud risks and backups are outlined, but alerting, migration/cutover, rollback and remote restore procedures are not detailed or rehearsed.
tasks.next: Create a target-specific staging, monitoring, rollback and disaster-recovery runbook.

priorities.reason: Protect the operational database and sessions before involving other shop devices.
priorities.acceptance: Approved certificate trust, separated service/provisioner access, renewal and new non-demo operational credentials pass acceptance; keep the implemented fictional staging environment separate.

priorities.reason: The shop must remain usable when external internet disconnects.
priorities.acceptance: A phone and second PC complete checkout and repayments through WAN loss and reconnection using trusted HTTPS.

priorities.reason: Receipt failures directly interrupt counter operations.
priorities.acceptance: Owner accepts both intended paper widths, long receipts, reprinting and the actual cutter/driver behavior.

priorities.reason: Validate fast and accurate scanning with the hardware cashiers will actually use.
priorities.acceptance: Rapid repeated scans, focus recovery and unknown codes preserve the expected cart quantities.

priorities.reason: Account revocation and recovery need dedicated evidence before workers use the system.
priorities.acceptance: Creation, deactivate/reactivate, password reset and all existing-session revocation checks pass.

priorities.reason: A backup file alone is not an operational recovery procedure.
priorities.acceptance: A restarted managed app and a restored copy reconcile stock, cash/credit totals and the last receipt with an operator present.

priorities.reason: Commercial rollout requires qualified acceptance outside the codebase.
priorities.acceptance: Owner records external review decisions and all blocking findings are resolved.

knownIssues.title: Bounded catalog and history views
knownIssues.detail: Several selectors and batch/customer/ledger views cap matches; add server pagination before larger-scale operation.

knownIssues.title: PDF text coverage
knownIssues.detail: Downloaded slips transliterate to ASCII; unsupported scripts become question marks. Browser receipts retain Unicode.

knownIssues.title: Receipt identity is not fully historical
knownIssues.detail: Old receipts use current store/customer display details. Decide the required immutable archival identity.

knownIssues.title: Pending operation recovery belongs to one tab
knownIssues.detail: Closing an uncertain checkout/payment tab can lose its saved request key. Operators must reconcile history before re-entering it.

futureScope: Expenses, cash-drawer shifts and net-profit accounting
Direct printer/spooler integration beyond browser printing
A dark theme and additional visual customization
Bidirectional cloud synchronization (explicitly outside the initial release)
